"So, Kavitha, when's the wedding?" Salma Aunty asked, loud enough for the whole Eid table to hear.

Last Diwali, at twenty-one, I, Yusuf, went home to Aligarh and faced the questions. What job? What salary? When will you marry? My uncle Kunal even asked if I'd saved for a house yet.
I'm in my final year of design. I don't have a job offer. I'm not dating anyone.

The second night, I tried something else. When he asked, I smiled. "I'll tell you when there's news, Chacha. Tell me about your garden?"
